# LLMs.txt — Portable Fallback

Use when a documentation site needs an AI-friendly index.

## Workflow

1. Inspect the current docs information architecture.
2. Select canonical high-value pages.
3. Write concise descriptions and stable links.
4. Exclude duplicate, generated or low-value pages.
5. Validate links and scope.
6. Keep the index synchronized with major docs changes.

The index is a navigation aid, not a substitute for authoritative documentation.

Follow the current llms.txt convention used by the target ecosystem rather than relying on stale syntax from memory.
